warnings.headline: Status Yellow - Rain warning for Cork, Waterford
warnings.description:
Spells of heavy rain.

Be aware of potential impacts:

  • Difficult travelling conditions
  • Localised flooding possible
  • Poor visibility

warnings.headline: Rain and Wind warning for Kerry
warnings.description:
Spells of heavy rain along with strong and gusty southeasterly winds.

Be aware of potential impacts:

  • Debris, loose objects displaced
  • Difficult travelling conditions
  • Localised flooding possible
